    (fun _ => a)

:= by

  rw [ite_apply]

  split

  · simp

proof:

  have h2 : (#v[a] ++ v)[(0 : Nat)] = #v[a][(0 : Nat)] := Vector.getElem_append_left (by omega)

name: Spec.Vector_ofFnM
statement:
@[spec]
theorem Spec.Vector_ofFnM {n : Nat} {α : Type}
  (inv : Prop)
  (f : Fin n → ZKBuilder f α)
  (postStep : Fin n → α → Prop)
  (hStep : ∀ (i : Fin n),
    ⦃ λ _e => ⌜inv⌝ ⦄
    f i
    ⦃ ⇓? s _e => ⌜postStep i s ∧ inv⌝ ⦄
  ) :
    ⦃ λ _e => ⌜inv⌝ ⦄
    Vector.ofFnM fun (x : Fin n) => f x
    ⦃ ⇓? v _e => ⌜inv ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), postStep i v[i]⌝ ⦄
proof:
:= by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      
      simp only [Vector.ofFnM_zero]
      
      apply Triple.pure
      
      apply SPred.pure_elim' (fun h_inv => ?_)
      apply SPred.pure_intro
      exact ⟨h_inv, fun i => i.elim0⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      
      rw [Vector.ofFnM_succ']
      mintro h_inv ∀e
      mpure h_inv
      
      mspec (hStep 0)
      mrename_i h0
      mpure h0
      
      have ih_inst := ih (f := fun i => f i.succ) (postStep := fun i => postStep i.succ)
        (fun i => hStep i.succ)
      mspec ih_inst
      mrename_i h_rest
      mpure h_rest
      
      mintro ∀e'
      mpure_intro
      obtain ⟨h_inv', h_all⟩ := h_rest
      obtain ⟨h_post0, _⟩ := h0
      constructor
      · exact h_inv'
      · intro i
        
        
        
        cases i using Fin.cases with
        | zero =>
          
          simp only [vector_cast_append_getElem_zero]
          exact h_post0
        | succ i' =>
          
          simp only [vector_cast_append_getElem_succ]
          exact h_all i'

name: c_step_soundness
statement:
theorem c_step_soundness (s : State) (s_bv : SHA3.State) (x : Fin 5)
    (h_eq : eqState s s_bv)
    (cBV_fn : Fin 5 → BitVec 64)
    (hcBV : ∀ x, cBV_fn x = s_bv.get x 0 ^^^ s_bv.get x 1 ^^^ s_bv.get x 2 ^^^ s_bv.get x 3 ^^^ s_bv.get x 4) :
  ⦃ λ _e => ⌜True⌝ ⦄
  (do xor64 (← xor64 (← xor64 (← xor64 (s.get x 0) (s.get x 1)) (s.get x 2)) (s.get x 3)) (s.get x 4))
  ⦃ ⇓? o _e => ⌜eqF o (cBV_fn x) ∧ True⌝ ⦄
proof:
:= by
  mintro _ ∀e'
  
  mspec (xor64.soundness (bv1 := s_bv.get x 0) (bv2 := s_bv.get x 1) _ _)
  · simp; exact ⟨state_get_lane_eq s s_bv x 0 h_eq, state_get_lane_eq s s_bv x 1 h_eq⟩
  mrename_i h1; mpure h1
  
  mspec (xor64.soundness (bv1 := s_bv.get x 0 ^^^ s_bv.get x 1) (bv2 := s_bv.get x 2) _ _)
  · simp; exact ⟨h1, state_get_lane_eq s s_bv x 2 h_eq⟩
  mrename_i h2; mpure h2
  
  mspec (xor64.soundness (bv1 := s_bv.get x 0 ^^^ s_bv.get x 1 ^^^ s_bv.get x 2) (bv2 := s_bv.get x 3) _ _)
  · simp; exact ⟨h2, state_get_lane_eq s s_bv x 3 h_eq⟩
  mrename_i h3; mpure h3
  
  mspec (xor64.soundness (bv1 := s_bv.get x 0 ^^^ s_bv.get x 1 ^^^ s_bv.get x 2 ^^^ s_bv.get x 3) (bv2 := s_bv.get x 4) _ _)
  · simp; exact ⟨h3, state_get_lane_eq s s_bv x 4 h_eq⟩
  mrename_i h4; mpure h4
  
  mintro ∀e''
  mpure_intro
  rw [hcBV]
  exact ⟨h4, trivial⟩

name: d_step_soundness
statement:
theorem d_step_soundness (cF : Vector (ZKExpr f) 5) (cBV : Vector (BitVec 64) 5) (x : Fin 5)
    (h_c : ∀ i : Fin 5, eqF (cF.get i) (cBV.get i))
    (dBV_fn : Fin 5 → BitVec 64)
    (hdBV : ∀ x, dBV_fn x = cBV[(x.val + 4) % 5] ^^^ (cBV[(x.val + 1) % 5]).rotateLeft 1) :
  ⦃ λ _e => ⌜True⌝ ⦄
  (do xor64 (cF.get ⟨(x.val + 4) % 5, by omega⟩) (← rotateLeft64 (cF.get ⟨(x.val + 1) % 5, by omega⟩) 1))
  ⦃ ⇓? o _e => ⌜eqF o (dBV_fn x) ∧ True⌝ ⦄
proof:
:= by
  have h1_lt : (x.val + 1) % 5 < 5 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h4_lt : (x.val + 4) % 5 < 5 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  mintro _ ∀e'
  
  have hc1 : eqF (cF.get ⟨(x.val + 1) % 5, h1_lt⟩) (cBV.get ⟨(x.val + 1) % 5, h1_lt⟩) :=
    h_c ⟨(x.val + 1) % 5, h1_lt⟩
  have hc4 : eqF (cF.get ⟨(x.val + 4) % 5, h4_lt⟩) (cBV.get ⟨(x.val + 4) % 5, h4_lt⟩) :=
    h_c ⟨(x.val + 4) % 5, h4_lt⟩
  mspec (rotateLeft64.soundness (bv1 := cBV.get ⟨(x.val + 1) % 5, h1_lt⟩) (bv2 := 1) _ _)
  · simp; exact ⟨hc1, rfl⟩
  mrename_i h_rot; mpure h_rot
  
  mspec (xor64.soundness (bv1 := cBV.get ⟨(x.val + 4) % 5, h4_lt⟩) (bv2 := (cBV.get ⟨(x.val + 1) % 5, h1_lt⟩).rotateLeft 1) _ _)
  · simp; exact ⟨hc4, h_rot⟩
  mrename_i hdx; mpure hdx
  
  mintro ∀e''
  mpure_intro
  constructor
  · simp only [hdBV]
    exact hdx
  · trivial

name: lanes_step_soundness
statement:
theorem lanes_step_soundness (s : State) (s_bv : SHA3.State)
    (dF : Vector (ZKExpr f) 5) (dBV : Vector (BitVec 64) 5)
    (i : Fin 25) (h_s : eqState s s_bv) (h_d : ∀ j : Fin 5, eqF (dF.get j) (dBV.get j))
    (laneBV_fn : Fin 25 → BitVec 64)
    (hlaneBV : ∀ i, laneBV_fn i = s_bv.get ⟨i.val % 5, by omega⟩ ⟨i.val / 5, by omega⟩ ^^^ dBV[i.val % 5]) :
  ⦃ λ _e => ⌜True⌝ ⦄
  (let x := i.val % 5
   let y := i.val / 5
   xor64 (s.get ⟨x, by omega⟩ ⟨y, by omega⟩) dF[x])
  ⦃ ⇓? o _e => ⌜eqF o (laneBV_fn i) ∧ True⌝ ⦄
proof:
:= by
  have hx_lt : i.val % 5 < 5 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have hy_lt : i.val / 5 < 5 := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by omega)
  mintro _ ∀e'
  
  have hs_lane : eqF (s.get ⟨i.val % 5, hx_lt⟩ ⟨i.val / 5, hy_lt⟩) s_bv.lanes[i] := by
    have := state_get_lane_eq s s_bv ⟨i.val % 5, hx_lt⟩ ⟨i.val / 5, hy_lt⟩ h_s
    simp only [eqF] at this ⊢
    have idx_eq : (i.val / 5) * 5 + i.val % 5 = i.val := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_add_mod i.val 5
    simp only [idx_eq] at this
    exact this
  have hd_elem : eqF dF[i.val % 5] (dBV.get ⟨i.val % 5, hx_lt⟩) := by
    have := h_d ⟨i.val % 5, hx_lt⟩
    simp only [Vector.get_eq_getElem] at this
    simp only [eqF] at this ⊢
    exact this
  mspec (xor64.soundness (bv1 := s_bv.lanes[i]) (bv2 := dBV.get ⟨i.val % 5, hx_lt⟩) _ _)
  · simp; exact ⟨hs_lane, hd_elem⟩
  mrename_i hli; mpure hli
  mintro ∀e''
  mpure_intro
  constructor
  · 
    simp only [hlaneBV, Vector.get_eq_getElem] at hli ⊢
    simp only [eqF] at hli ⊢
    have lanes_eq : s_bv.lanes[i] = s_bv.get ⟨i.val % 5, hx_lt⟩ ⟨i.val / 5, hy_lt⟩ := by
      simp only [SHA3.State.get]
      have idx_eq : (i.val / 5) * 5 + i.val % 5 = i.val := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_add_mod i.val 5
      simp only [idx_eq, Fin.getElem_fin]
    rw [lanes_eq] at hli
    exact hli
  · trivial

statement:
lemma ult_val [NZ : NeZero n] [h: GtTwo n] {x y : ZMod n}
  (hx : x.val ≤ 1) (hy : y.val ≤ 1) :
  (1 - x - y + x * y + x * y).val
    = 1 - x.val + x.val * y.val - y.val + x.val * y.val
proof:
:= by

    have hz : x*y + (x*y + (1 - x - y)) = (x*y + x*y + (1 - x)) - y := by
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]
    have k := congrArg ZMod.val hz
    conv =>
      lhs
      simp [add_comm]
      rw [k]

    haveI F : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨(by decide : 1 < 2).trans h.out⟩
    rw [ZMod.val_sub]
    simp [ZMod.val_add]
    simp [ZMod.val_mul]
    rw [ZMod.val_sub]
    rw [ZMod.val_one]
    simp [add_assoc]
    simp [add_left_comm, add_comm]

    cases split_one hx
    · case inl XL =>
      simp [XL]
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
      apply F.out
    · case inr XR =>
      simp [XR]
      cases split_one hy
      · case inl YL =>
        simp [YL]
      · case inr YR =>
        simp [YR]
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
        apply h.out

    rw [ZMod.val_one]
    · apply hx
    · simp [ZMod.val_add, ZMod.val_mul]
      rw [ZMod.val_sub]
      · rw [ZMod.val_one]
        cases split_one hy
        · case inl YL => simp [YL]
        · case inr YR =>
          simp [YR]
          cases split_one hx
          · case inl XL =>
            simp [XL]
            rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
            have := GtTwo.gt_two (G := h)
            omega
          · case inr XR =>
            simp [XR]
            rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
            omega
            apply h.out
      · rw [ZMod.val_one]
        apply hx

lemma one_val n [NZ : NeZero n] [G : GtTwo n] {x y : ZMod n} (hx : x.val ≤ 1) :
  (1 - x).val = (1 - x.val) % n
proof:
:= by
  have NZ' := @NeZero.ne _ _ _ NZ
  have G' := GtTwo.gt_two (G := G)
  have h': Fact (1 < n) := ⟨lt_trans Nat.one_lt_two G'⟩
  rw [ZMod.val_sub]
  simp [ZMod.val_one]
  cases split_one hx
  · case inl A =>
    rw [A] at hx ⊢
    · simp
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
      ·
        cases n
        · contradiction
        · simp ; omega
  · case inr B =>
    simp [B]
  simp [ZMod.val_one]
  apply hx

name: ZMod.plus_ge_mult
proof:
:= by
  simp [ZMod.val_mul]
  simp [ZMod.val_add]
  match (⟨ split_one hx, split_one hy ⟩ : _ ∧ _) with
  | ⟨ .inl A, .inl B ⟩ => simp [A, B]
  | ⟨ .inl A, .inr B ⟩ => simp [A, B]
  | ⟨ .inr A, .inl B ⟩ => simp [A, B]
  | ⟨ .inr A, .inr B ⟩ =>
    simp [A, B]
    have H : 2 < n := h'.out
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] <;> try omega
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] <;> omega

name: or_val
proof:
:= by
  simp [ZMod.val_sub (ZMod.plus_ge_mult hx hy)]
  simp [ZMod.val_mul]
  simp [ZMod.val_add]
  match (⟨ split_one hx, split_one hy ⟩ : _ ∧ _) with
  | ⟨ .inl A, .inl B ⟩ => simp [A, B]
  | ⟨ .inl A, .inr B ⟩ => simp [A, B]
  | ⟨ .inr A, .inl B ⟩ => simp [A, B]
  | ⟨ .inr A, .inr B ⟩ =>
    simp [A, B]
    rcases n with _ | _ | _ | _
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp
      exact (lt_irrefl 2) h'.out
    · simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]

name: split_one
statement: lemma split_one {x : ℕ} : (x ≤ 1) → (x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
proof: := by omega

name: Nat.lt_sub
statement: lemma Nat.lt_sub {a : ℕ} (h: a ≤ 1) : (1 - a) ≤ 1
proof: := by omega

name: Nat.mux_if_then
statement:
lemma Nat.mux_if_then {a y x : ℕ} (h: a ≤ 1) :
  (1 - a) * x + (a * y) = if a == 0 then x else y
proof:
:= by
  apply split_one at h
  cases h <;> subst a <;> simp

name: BitVec.ofNat_mul
statement:
lemma BitVec.ofNat_mul {w a b : ℕ} :
  BitVec.ofNat w (a * b) = (BitVec.ofNat w a) * (BitVec.ofNat w b)
proof:
:= by
    rw [BitVec.ofNat, BitVec.ofNat, BitVec.ofNat]
    rw [Fin.Internal.ofNat, Fin.Internal.ofNat,  Fin.Internal.ofNat]
    apply congrArg
    simp_all
    apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
    simp_all

name: ult_bv
statement:
lemma ult_bv {x y : ℕ} (hx : x ≤ 1) (hy : y ≤ 1) :
  (BitVec.ofNat bw (1 - x + x * y - y))
  = (BitVec.ofNat bw 1 - BitVec.ofNat bw x + BitVec.ofNat bw x * BitVec.ofNat bw y - BitVec.ofNat bw y)
proof:
:= by
    apply split_one at hx
    apply split_one at hy
    apply Or.elim hx
    intro hx'
    apply Or.elim hy
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp
    intro hx'
    apply Or.elim hy
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp

name: BitVec.ofNat_sub
statement:
lemma BitVec.ofNat_sub  {bw x : ℕ} [h0: NeZero bw] (h : 1 ≥ x) :
  BitVec.ofNat bw (1 - x) = (BitVec.ofNat bw 1) - (BitVec.ofNat bw x)
proof:
:= by
    unfold BitVec.ofNat
    rw [Fin.Internal.ofNat, Fin.Internal.ofNat,  Fin.Internal.ofNat]
    apply congrArg
    simp_all
    apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
    simp_all
    cases x with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n => cases n with
         | zero =>
            simp
            have h' : 1 < 2^ bw := by
              apply (Nat.one_lt_two_pow h0.out)
            have h2 : 1 % 2^ bw  = 1 := by
              rw  [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
              apply h'
            rw [h2]
            rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt h')]
            simp
         | succ m =>
            exfalso
            simp at h

name: or_bv
statement:
lemma or_bv {x y : ℕ} {bw : ℕ}  (hx : x ≤ 1) (hy : y ≤ 1) :
  BitVec.ofNat bw ((x + y) - x*y) = BitVec.ofNat bw (x) + BitVec.ofNat bw (y) - BitVec.ofNat bw (x) *BitVec.ofNat bw (y)
proof:
:= by
    apply split_one at hx
    apply split_one at hy
    apply Or.elim hx
    intro hx'
    apply Or.elim hy
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp
    intro hx'
    apply Or.elim hy
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp
    intro hy'
    rw [hx']
    rw [hy']
    simp
    rw [BitVec.add_sub_cancel]

name: ZMod.val_sub_mod
statement:
lemma ZMod.val_sub_mod (h0 : Fact (1 < ff)) (h : x.val ≤ (1 : ZMod ff).val)
  : ((1 : ZMod ff) - x).val = (1 - x.val)%ff
proof:
:= by
  valify [h0] at h
  valify [h]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  try_apply_lemma_hyps [h]
  apply h0.out

name: Nat.val_sub_mod
statement:
lemma Nat.val_sub_mod (h0 : Fact (1 < ff)) (h : x ≤ 1)
  : (1 - (x%ff))%ff = (1 - x)%ff
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
  apply Nat.sub_le
  apply h0.out
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
  apply h
  apply h0.out
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
  apply Nat.sub_le
  apply h0.out
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
  apply h
  apply h0.out

name: GtTwo.gt_two
statement: theorem GtTwo.gt_two [G : GtTwo n] : 2 < n
proof:
:=
  G.out

name: extract_bv_rel
statement:
lemma extract_bv_rel {b: ℕ} {x : ZMod ff} [h0: NeZero b]  :
  some (bool_to_bv b bf) = map_f_to_bv b x
  ↔ (x.val <= 1 ∧ (if bf then 1#b else 0#b) = BitVec.ofNat b x.val)
proof:
:= by
  unfold map_f_to_bv
  unfold bool_to_bv
  dsimp
  simp
  intros h
  constructor
  intros hx
  cases a: x.val with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => decide
    | succ m =>
      exfalso
      rw [a] at h
      unfold BitVec.ofNat at h
      unfold Fin.Internal.ofNat at h
      have h' := congrArg (fun x => x.toFin.val) h
      simp at h'
      have mod_eq : (m + 2) % (2^b) = m + 2 := by
        rw [← a]
        apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
        apply hx
      rw [← h'] at mod_eq
      cases g : bf with
      | true =>
        rw [g] at mod_eq
        simp at mod_eq
        have h1 : 1 % 2 ^ b = 1 := by
          apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.one_lt_two_pow h0.out)
        rw [h1] at mod_eq
        simp at mod_eq
      | false =>
        rw [g] at mod_eq
        simp at mod_eq
  intro h
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
  apply h
  apply Nat.one_lt_two_pow h0.out

name: ZMod.eq_if_val
statement:
lemma ZMod.eq_if_val [NeZero ff]  (a b : ZMod ff) :
  (a = b) ↔ (a.val = b.val)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  intros h
  rw [h]
  intros h
  apply ZMod.val_injective at h
  exact h

name: BitVec_ofNat_eq_iff
statement:
lemma BitVec_ofNat_eq_iff (n : ℕ) {x y : ℕ} (hx : x < 2^n) (hy : y < 2^n) :
  (x = y) ↔ (BitVec.ofNat n x = BitVec.ofNat n y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro h
  rw [h]
  intro h
  unfold BitVec.ofNat at h
  unfold Fin.Internal.ofNat at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun x => x.toFin.val) h
  simp at h
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_modEq at h'
  have hxy : x % 2^n = y := h' hy
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] at hxy
  apply hxy
  apply hx

name: Nat.mul_comm_ofNat
statement:
lemma Nat.mul_comm_ofNat (a n : Nat) :
   (OfNat.ofNat n) * a = a* (OfNat.ofNat n : Nat)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_comm ]

name: mul_comm_num_left
statement:
lemma mul_comm_num_left (n t : ℕ) :
  (n : ℕ) * t = t * (n : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Nat.mul_comm (n : ℕ) t

name: BitVec.toNatLT
statement:
lemma BitVec.toNatLT {bw} {a : BitVec bw}:
  a.toNat <= 2^bw
proof:
:= by
  have h := a.toFin.isLt        
  exact Nat.le_of_lt h
